description: This file defines an abstract class for handling MQTT subscriptions within a messaging service, including management of source-actor pairs, subscription lifecycle, and interaction with MQTT clients. It provides methods to prepare, initiate, and clear subscriptions, as well as handling MQTT-specific details such as QoS and connection sources.

classes.name: AbstractMqttSubscriptionHandler
classes.description: An abstract class managing MQTT subscription lifecycle, source handling, and actor communication for MQTT connections.

classes.name: MqttConsumer
classes.description: A container class pairing a Source with its associated ActorRef for MQTT message consumption.

classes.name: SubscribeAction
classes.description: A functional interface defining the subscription method for MQTT clients.

methods.name: toMqttSubscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to compute MQTT SUBSCRIBE message from a source.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of current source-actor pairs as MqttConsumer objects.

methods.name: handleMqttConsumer
methods.description: Adds a source and its consumer actor to the internal map.

methods.name: allConsumersReady
methods.description: Checks if all sources have corresponding consumer actors initialized.

methods.name: clearConsumerActors
methods.description: Removes all consumer actors, executing a provided callback for each.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Initiates the subscription process for all sources when consumers are ready, returning a future list of subscription acknowledgments.

methods.name: asAddressQoSPair
methods.description: Prepares a pair of address and QoS for subscription.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.parameter: final Source source, final S mqtt3Subscribe, final ActorRef consumerActor
methods.description: Performs the actual MQTT subscription for a source with a given subscribe message and actor.

methods.name: prepareSubscriptions
methods.description: Generates a map of sources to subscribe messages based on the connection sources.
